headline: President Bush ordered that certain existing federal advisory committees keep operating instead of expiring.
what_it_does: This executive order extends the life of certain federal advisory committees, which are groups that give advice to the President or federal agencies. Without an order like this, such committees can expire after a set period. No abstract was provided, so the specific committees and the length of the extension are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the affected federal advisory committees
who_it_affects.how: They can continue serving and advising the government instead of having their committees end.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies served by these committees
who_it_affects.how: They keep access to the advice these committees provide.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 17, 2003; the specific effective dates are not stated in the source provided.
